title: Worksheet 4.3 — Quadratic Vertex Form
subject: Algebra 2
sourceText:
Algebra 2 — Worksheet 4.3: Quadratic Vertex Form
Name: ________    Date: ________

Rewrite each quadratic in vertex form. Show every line of your work.

1) y = x² + 8x − 20
   Worked example:
   Line 1 — group the x terms:            y = (x² + 8x) − 20
   Line 2 — add and subtract (b/2)²:      y = (x² + 8x + 16) − 16 − 20
   Line 3 — factor and simplify:          y = (x + 4)² − 36

2) y = x² − 12x + 7

3) The path of a water arc is modeled by h(t) = −16t² + 64t + 40,
   where h is height in feet and t is time in seconds.
   (a) Rewrite h in vertex form.
   (b) State the maximum height and when it occurs.

Note for problem 4: you will meet complex numbers here. Recall i = √−1,
so expressions like √−9 become 3i.

4) Solve x² + 4x + 13 = 0 by completing the square.

marks.label: completing the square
marks.why: The example uses (b/2)² without naming it — that's the completing-the-square move Problem 2 needs.

steps.text: For y = x² + bx + c, cut b in half. That number is b/2.
Square it: (b/2)² is the number that turns x² + bx into a perfect square.
Add AND subtract (b/2)² — the addition completes the square, the subtraction keeps the equation true.
Factor the result: x² + bx + (b/2)² = (x + b/2)².
In the worked example, b = 8, so (b/2)² = 4² = 16 — exactly the 16 you see appear and disappear in Line 2.

check.prompt: Apply the move: what number completes the square for x² + 10x + ____ ?

marks.label: the imaginary unit i
marks.why: The note uses i = √−1 without naming it — that's how Problem 4 finishes a negative root.

steps.text: √−1 gets its own name: i, the imaginary unit. Its defining property is i · i = −1.
To root a negative, pull the negative out first: √(−n) = √n · i whenever n > 0.
Check it against the worksheet note: √−9 = √9 · i = 3i.
Your answer lives in the complex world now — a + bi form is a complete, valid solution.

check.prompt: Apply the move: write √−49 in terms of i.

nextLine.setup: Problem 2: y = x² − 12x + 7. You grouped already: y = (x² − 12x) + 7. Now write YOUR Line 2 — the one where you add and subtract (b/2)² inside the group.

expect.hint: Half of −12 is −6, and (−6)² = 36. Add 36 inside the parentheses, subtract 36 outside them.
